role: Fixed holdout design written before evaluating the redesigned primary interval
seed_derivation: First 16 SHA256 bytes interpreted as a little-endian unsigned integer; exact entropy stored as decimal string
stream_plan: SeedSequence(entropy).spawn(4), one case in listed phi order; case.spawn(160); each trial.spawn(2) supplies separate PCG64 noise and uint64 bootstrap-seed streams

analysis_options.meaning_of_pressure: Synthetic scalar channel for statistical-method calibration only

planned_outputs: Primary batch-means Student-t interval: eligibility, hits/count, conditional coverage and 95% Wilson interval per case
Secondary exploratory moving-block percentile interval: same measures per case
All unavailability reasons and reported-and-covering fraction of all trials
Recorded exact implementation digest and unchanged original MBB baseline
limitations: One finite Gaussian dependence family does not prove coverage for molecular dynamics or all stationary processes
Coverage among reported intervals conditions on diagnostic gates; eligibility is always shown
Wilson bounds are per estimate, without simultaneous multiple-case coverage claims
Cases, streams, sample counts and options are fixed before redesigned-method scores; any score-driven method tuning must be disclosed and these results relabeled exploratory
